title: Why “chân giò” is trending in VN: 200+ searches, the facts (October 26, 2026)
description: “chân giò” is trending in VN with 200+ searches reported by Google. The verified coverage behind the spike, from Báo Dân trí and 2 more.

sections.heading: What is trending: “chân giò”
paragraphs: “chân giò” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for VN (snapshot taken 2026-10-26T19:19:27+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 200 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Báo Dân trí, Báo VietNamNet, Laodong.vn. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Chân giò đóng hộp ế ẩm, giám đốc dùng ChatGPT đổi nhãn khâu nhục” — Báo Dân trí
“Mua khâu nhục Thất Khê, mở hộp thấy chân giò: Hé lộ thủ đoạn của người bán” — Báo VietNamNet
“Công an làm rõ nguồn gốc 500 hộp khâu nhục giả nhãn mác Lạng Sơn” — Laodong.vn

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Mon, 26 Oct 2026 09:10:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-10-26T19:19:27+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-10-26T19:19:38+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.

faq.a: Google's Trending Now feed links the spike to coverage from Báo Dân trí, Báo VietNamNet, Laodong.vn. The associated headlines are: “Chân giò đóng hộp ế ẩm, giám đốc dùng ChatGPT đổi nhãn khâu nhục” (Báo Dân trí); “Mua khâu nhục Thất Khê, mở hộp thấy chân giò: Hé lộ thủ đoạn của người bán” (Báo VietNamNet); “Công an làm rõ nguồn gốc 500 hộp khâu nhục giả nhãn mác Lạng Sơn” (Laodong.vn).

faq.q: How many people searched for “chân giò”?
faq.a: Google reports at least 200 searches in VN as of the feed snapshot. This is a published lower bound, not an exact count.
This snapshot covers VN. The same term may trend differently in other regions.
